# KI-145 — Web: local full-app browser spec and visual check

**Lane:** web · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KI-143 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/composition/local/local.browser.spec.ts` (new), `apps/web/src/composition/local/fake-local-helper.ts` (new)

## Outcome

One Playwright spec builds the **real** local web app and drives it in headless Chromium. The build uses KI-143's `vite.local.config.mjs`, the same entry, config and guard as `build:local`. An in-test fake of the helper's `/api/local/**` API answers every request, long-polls included.

The spec proves that the whole local app works with no Khala servers and no sign-in:
- the channel list;
- opening a channel;
- sending a message (it appears once);
- an agent message arriving over long-poll, attributed to the agent;
- a "joined" event pill;
- the roster with listening modes, including the confirmed-mode echo;
- renaming an agent;
- creating a channel and the Add agent link;
- Settings (username, colour when shipped, theme).

Every request the page makes stays on the page's origin, and none touches `/api/human`.

The spec also saves 16 screenshots (4 views × 1280/390 × dark/light) to a directory from an env var. The PR body lists every visual drift from the hosted harness screenshots.

## Context and evidence

- **D4:** the full web app, "the same exact UI and functionality as khala.aiur.team". **AE5:** channel list, timeline, composer, roster and settings render as on khala.aiur.team. **AE6:** the roster shows the agent's confirmed mode. **AE7:** profile changes and agent rename. **AE10:** the browser bundle opens zero non-loopback connections.
- The plan's verification contract for UI tickets is "screenshots at 1280 and 390, dark and light". The operator's direction is to screenshot and self-critique before marking ready, with minimal labeling and polished UI.
- The plan's integration ledger says "UI chrome (KI-144, KI-145) ↔ local entry (KI-143)". This ticket is the first end-to-end proof that the KI-140..KI-144 web pieces compose correctly against the L5/L6 wire. KI-160 later repeats a subset against the real helper.
- Research (`research/web-seam.md` §7) names the templates:
  - `apps/web/src/composition/human/device-loss.browser.spec.ts:36-60`, for Vite `build` + `preview` + Chromium;
  - `apps/web/src/features/profile/browser-harness/main.tsx:1-29` with `apps/web/src/features/profile/username-setup.browser.spec.ts:9-47`, for a real adapter over Playwright-intercepted HTTP.
  - Here the "harness" **is** the production local entry; there is no harness page.

## Scope

1. `fake-local-helper.ts`: a transport-agnostic, in-memory fake of the helper's owner-facing API. Its handlers follow L5/L6 exactly and derive state by the L3 replay rules. Long-polls are released by appends. It also records requests, unhandled routes and guard violations.
2. `local.browser.spec.ts`:
   - builds with `vite.local.config.mjs` into a temp dir and previews it;
   - routes `**/api/local/**` to the fake;
   - runs the flows below at 1280 px, with the phone checks at 390 px;
   - takes the 16 screenshots when `KHALA_LOCAL_SCREENSHOT_DIR` is set.
3. A drift review against the hosted harness screenshots, written in the PR body. No code ships for it.

## Non-goals

- Any production code change in `apps/web/src/**`, the helper or contracts.
  - When a flow fails because of a port bug, the fix belongs to the owning ticket's area: KI-140 (http/session/profile/agent names), KI-141 (substrate/timeline/send), KI-142 (conversations/members/links/modes cache), KI-143 (`ports.ts` composition), KI-144 (account chrome).
  - Report it to the Executor with the failing assertion. Do not patch it here.
- Visual **baselines** (`*.visual.spec.ts` and `playwright.visual.config.ts`). These screenshots are review evidence; nothing is committed under `apps/web/src/**/*-snapshots/`.
- The real helper, cookies, `/open/<token>` and the Host/Origin guards: **KI-131**, **KI-137**, **KI-160**.
- Agent processes, wake and delivery: **KI-160** and **KI-161**.

## Contract and invariants

The fake implements these routes, verbatim from contracts L5 and L6. The browser authenticates by cookie, and every mutation must carry `x-khala-local: 1`.

```ts
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/me
export type LocalMe = { userId: string; roomId: string; roomName: string; membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave'; invitedBy?: string; displayName: string };
// POST /api/local/rooms/:roomId/join                 body {} → LocalJoined   (invite → join; appends the join member event; idempotent when already joined)
export type LocalJoined = { seq: number; ts: number };   // seq of the caller's own join event = the live cutoff
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/events?after=<seq>&wait=<0..25>
export type LocalEventsPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; next: number };   // events with seq > after, ascending, at most 200; next = last seq returned or `after`
//   answers immediately when an event with seq > after exists, else holds up to `wait` seconds and answers {events:[], next:after}
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/messages?before=<eventId>&limit=<1..100>
export type LocalHistoryPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; nextBefore?: string };   // m.room.message + com.khala.event.v1 only, oldest first, strictly older than `before`; nextBefore = oldest eventId when older ones exist
// POST /api/local/rooms/:roomId/send
export type LocalSendRequest = { txnId: string; type: 'm.room.message' | 'com.khala.event.v1'; content: Record<string, unknown> };   // txnId 1..64 chars [A-Za-z0-9._-]
export type LocalSendResult = { eventId: string };   // replays the same eventId for a repeated (sender, txnId)
// GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/members
export type LocalMember = {
  userId: string;                    // "@khala_owner:local" | "@agent-<8hex>:local"; the web uses it as Participant.matrixUserId
  participantId: string;             // = userId (the web's ParticipantId)
  ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID;    // every member belongs to the one owner
  deviceId: string;                  // agents "KH_LOCAL_<8hex>", the owner LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID; the web's authorDeviceId
  displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex';
  ownerLabel?: string;               // agents: the owner's username (Participant.ownerLabel)
  membership: 'invite' | 'join';
  listeningMode?: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async';   // agents only; DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE when never echoed
};
export type LocalMembersResponse = { members: LocalMember[] };   // present members only
```

```ts
// GET    /api/local/channels?since=<revision>&wait=<0..25>    → LocalChannelsPage   newest activity first
//   answers immediately when `since` is absent or differs from the current revision; else holds up to `wait` s
export type LocalChannelsPage = { revision: number; channels: LocalChannelSummary[] };   // revision: helper-wide counter bumped on every append/create/delete (in memory; restarts at 0)
export type LocalChannelSummary = {
  roomId: string; name: string; createdAt: string; lastSeq: number; lastTs: number;
  preview: string | null;                                  // body of the latest m.room.message (m.text), else null
  lastSender?: { userId: string; displayName: string };    // sender of that message
  members: { userId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex' }[];   // present members, owner first
};
// GET    /api/local/channels/:roomId                          → LocalChannelSummary | 404 not_found
// GET    /api/local/channels/by-operation/:operationId        → { roomId: string } | 404 not_found   (browser create reconciliation, ChannelSubstrate.findCreatedRoom)
// POST   /api/local/channels           body {name, operationId?} → LocalChannelCreated   (name 1..64 chars, trimmed; appends create + owner join; operationId 1..64 [A-Za-z0-9._-] is stored in the create content and is idempotent)
export type LocalChannelCreated = { roomId: string; name: string; selfLink: string; shareLink: string; openUrl: string; expiresAt: string };
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/links                    → { shareLink: string; expiresAt: string }   a fresh single-use join link
// POST   /api/local/channels/:roomId/mode   body {agent, mode, txnId} → { eventId: string }   appends com.khala.listening_mode.v1 {v:1, agent, mode} from the owner (txnId dedup); 404 for a non-agent
// POST   /api/local/agents/:userId/name     body {name}        → AgentRenameResult {matrixUserId, name}   (`packages/contracts/src/m1/agent-names.ts:5-6`, same shape as hosted /api/human/agents/rename)
// GET    /api/local/profile                                   → OwnerProfileView   (also the browser's session check: 401 without the cookie)
// POST   /api/local/profile/username  body {username}         → { username }   400 {"error":"invalid_username","reason":NameError}; renames agents still on a default name (isDefaultAgentName) in every channel, like hosted renameDefaultAgents
// POST   /api/local/profile/color     body {color}            → { color }      400 {"error":"invalid_color"}
// POST   /api/local/profile/initials  body {initials|null}    → { initials }   follows the hosted initials contract once PR #986 merges; until then 1–2 letters [A-Za-z] or null
```

L7: `OwnerProfileView = { userId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID; ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID; username: string; suggestion: string; color: HumanColorId; initials?: string }`.

L3 replay rules (the fake derives state with these), verbatim:
- Members = the last `m.room.member` per `content.user`. A member is **present** when its membership is `invite` or `join`.
- Display names come only from member events. A rename is a new member event with the same membership and a new `displayname`, sent by the owner.
- Listening mode of an agent = `content['com.khala.listening_mode']` of its last member event, else `sync` (`DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE`, `packages/contracts/src/m1/listening-mode.ts:8`). The agent writes it (echo after applying an owner command), exactly like the Matrix member-state echo (`packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts` `publishListeningMode`).
- Channel name = the last `m.room.name` content, else the create content.

L5 join announcement, verbatim:

```json
{"type":"com.khala.event.v1","content":{"v":1,"kind":"member","summary":"kevin-Codex joined","status":"info","source":{"system":"khala-local"},"body":"kevin-Codex joined"}}
```

### Invariants the spec asserts

1. **Same origin only.** Every request the browser context makes (`context.on('request')`) has `new URL(url).origin === origin`, or the scheme `data:`/`blob:`.
   - No URL contains `/api/human`, `googleapis`, `gstatic` or `khala.aiur.team`.
   - No request goes to the homeserver: none to `/_matrix/`.
2. **Mutation header.** Every non-GET `/api/local/**` request carries `x-khala-local: 1`. The fake records violations; the list must be empty.
3. **Fully faked.** The fake's `unhandled` list is empty at the end. Every route the adapter called is one of the L5/L6 routes above.
4. **No page errors and no CSP violations** under the helper's CSP, applied as a preview header (Step 3).
5. **`/` → `/conversations`.**
6. **One message per send.** After a send and the long-poll echo of the same event, the timeline shows the text exactly once.

### Steps

1. **`fake-local-helper.ts`.** Pure TypeScript: no `node:*` imports and no Playwright import, so the boundary checker stays green.
   - It is not a `*.spec.ts`, so `scripts/check-terminology.mjs` scans its string literals.
   - Match routes with **regex literals** (for example `/^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/events$/`), which the checker does not scan.
   - Any string literal containing "rooms" needs `// khala-terminology-allow: helper API route path` on the line above.
   ```ts
   export type FakeRequest = Readonly<{ method: string; path: string; query: URLSearchParams; headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>; body: unknown }>;
   export type FakeResponse = Readonly<{ status: number; json?: unknown }>;
   export type FakeLocalHelper = Readonly<{
     handle(request: FakeRequest): Promise<FakeResponse>;
     log: readonly FakeRequest[]; unhandled: readonly string[]; violations: readonly string[];
     modeCommands: readonly { roomId: string; agent: string; mode: string; txnId: string }[];
     agentSays(roomId: string, userId: string, body: string): LocalEvent;
     announce(roomId: string, summary: string): LocalEvent;            // com.khala.event.v1 from the owner, content from encodeChannelEvent
     echoMode(roomId: string, userId: string, mode: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async'): LocalEvent;
     close(): void;                                                    // releases every held long-poll with an empty answer
   }>;
   export function createFakeLocalHelper(seed?: { maxWaitMs?: number }): FakeLocalHelper;   // default seed = the worked example
   ```
   - **State:**
     - `channels: Map<roomId, { events: LocalEvent[]; operationId?: string; createdAt: string }>`;
     - `owner`;
     - a helper-wide `revision` that every append, create, delete and profile change bumps;
     - `waiters: Set<() => void>`, released on every bump.
   - **Ids:**
     - events: `$` + the seq zero-padded to 22 characters;
     - new rooms: `!` + 22 base64url characters + `:local` (for example `!new00000000000000000001:local`);
     - share links: `http://127.0.0.1:47830/join/` + 43 base64url characters.
   - **Derived views**, per the L3 rules: members (present, owner first), `listeningMode` (`sync` default) and summaries.
     - `preview` is the latest `m.text` body.
     - Agents carry `ownerLabel: owner.username` and `deviceId: 'KH_LOCAL_' + <8 hex from the user id>`.
     - The owner carries `deviceId: 'KH_LOCAL_OWNER'`.
   - **Long-polls:**
     - `events?after&wait` and `channels?since&wait` answer at once when there is something new.
     - Otherwise they hold up to `min(wait * 1000, maxWaitMs)`; `maxWaitMs` defaults to 3000, which keeps teardown fast.
     - A bump releases them; they then answer with the new state (an `events` poll returns only `seq > after`).
   - **Mutations:**
     - If the `x-khala-local` header is not `'1'`, push `"<METHOD> <path>"` to `violations` and answer `403 {"error":"forbidden_origin"}`.
     - `send` dedups by (`@khala_owner:local`, `txnId`) and returns the same `eventId`.
     - `profile/username` validates `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2,32}$` (else `400 invalid_username`) and applies the cascade: every agent whose display name is `<old>-Claude`/`<old>-Codex` with an optional `-<n>` gets a member event with the new prefix.
     - `agents/:userId/name` appends a member event with the new `displayname` and answers `{ matrixUserId, name }`.
   - **Unknown routes:** push `"<METHOD> <path>"` to `unhandled` and answer `404 {"error":"not_found"}`.
2. **`local.browser.spec.ts`: setup.**
   1. `CONFIG = join(import.meta.dirname, '../../../vite.local.config.mjs')`.
   2. `build({ configFile: CONFIG, build: { outDir, emptyOutDir: true }, logLevel: 'error' })`.
   3. `preview({ configFile: CONFIG, build: { outDir }, preview: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, headers: { 'Content-Security-Policy': LOCAL_CSP } } })`.
   4. `origin = new URL(server.resolvedUrls!.local[0]!).origin`.
   5. One `browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 } })`.
   6. Wire the fake: `context.route('**/api/local/**', route => …)` calls `fake.handle({ method, path: url.pathname, query: url.searchParams, headers: request.headers(), body: request.postData() ? request.postDataJSON() : undefined })`, then `route.fulfill(status === 204 ? { status } : { status, json })`.
   7. `context.on('request', r => urls.push(r.url()))`.
   8. `context.addInitScript(…)` installs:
      - a `securitypolicyviolation` listener pushing to `window.__csp`;
      - a `navigator.clipboard.writeText` stub pushing to `window.__copied` (as `channel.browser.spec.ts` uses `window.__copied`).
3. **`LOCAL_CSP`.**
   - KI-131 pins `export const LOCAL_CSP = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'"` in `packages/agent/src/local/http.ts` (created by KI-131). The helper sends it on every HTML response.
   - `apps/web` must not import `packages/agent`, so inline the same literal in the spec.
   - Assert that `readFile(join(import.meta.dirname, '../../../../../packages/agent/src/local/http.ts'), 'utf8')` contains `` `export const LOCAL_CSP = "${LOCAL_CSP}"` ``, so drift fails loudly.
   - If a CSP violation shows up, do not loosen the spec. It is a KI-131 (`LOCAL_CSP`) or KI-143 (bundle) defect; report it.
4. **Flows.** Run them in one `test(…, { timeout: 180_000 })`, in this order on one page. Selectors are as at 5ad41c8b; refresh them at pickup, since #976 moves rename into the roster.
   - **F1 entry.**
     - `goto(origin + '/')`; the pathname becomes `/conversations`.
     - `.kh-cv` count is 2, and the first has `refactor` (newest activity first).
     - `document.fonts.check('16px "Space Grotesk"')` is `true`; the fonts load from same-origin `/assets/*.woff2`.
     - The cog menu has no `Log out` (KI-144).
   - **F2 open channel.**
     - Click `refactor`; the pathname is `/channels/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal`.
     - The `h1` is `refactor`, and a `.timeline__row` shows `@kevin-Codex can you review PR #12?`.
   - **F3 send.**
     - Fill the `Message` combobox with `hello agents` and click `Send`.
     - `fake.log` has exactly one `POST /api/local/rooms/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/send` with body `{ txnId: <string>, type: 'm.room.message', content: { msgtype: 'm.text', body: 'hello agents' } }`.
     - The pending row detaches (`.timeline__row--pending` with that text, `state: 'detached'`).
     - After 2 s more, `.timeline__row` with text `hello agents` has count exactly 1.
   - **F4 agent message over long-poll.**
     - `const event = fake.agentSays(R1, CL, 'On it. Reviewing PR #12 now.')`.
     - Within 5 s, `[data-event-id="<event.eventId>"]` is visible, and contains both the author name `kevin-Claude` and the body.
   - **F5 join pill.** `fake.announce(R1, 'kevin-Codex joined')`; within 5 s, `li.channel-event-pill` has text containing `kevin-Codex joined`.
   - **F6 roster and modes.**
     - Click `#kh-head-btn`. Both `.kh-rai[data-kh-agent="@agent-a1b2c3d4:local"]` and `…e5f6a7b8…` are present.
     - kevin-Claude's checked radio is `sync` and kevin-Codex's is `async`.
     - Click kevin-Claude's `[role="radio"][data-v="steer"]`.
       - `fake.modeCommands` deep-equals `[{ roomId: R1, agent: CL, mode: 'steer', txnId: <string> }]`.
       - The status `Waiting for kevin-Claude to switch…` is visible, and the checked radio stays as the UI shows it.

## Test scenarios

All in `apps/web/src/composition/local/local.browser.spec.ts`, run under `pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser`. Each F-step above is one scenario with the assertions given there:

1. F1 `/` → `/conversations`, two channels, fonts loaded from the same origin, no Log out.
2. F2 open channel: URL, heading and seeded message.
3. F3 send: exactly one POST with the exact body, and exactly one rendered row after the long-poll echo.
4. F4 agent message: rendered within 5 s from a held long-poll, attributed `kevin-Claude`.
5. F5 `kevin-Codex joined` renders as `li.channel-event-pill`.
6. F6 roster modes: initial `sync`/`async`, the POST captured, waiting status, the confirmed `steer` after the echo.
7. F7 rename: POST `{ name: 'Reviewer' }`, roster updated.
8. F8 add-agent link: POST captured, local link shown, copied.
9. F9 new channel: POST with `operationId`, navigation to the new channel.
10. F10 username `kev` (POST and the menu detail, cascade to `kev-Codex`), colour if shipped, theme persists across reload.
11. F11 phone: no overflow, back and roster work.
12. Final invariants: all requests same-origin, no `/api/human`, no `/_matrix/`, no violations, no unhandled routes, no CSP violations, no page errors.
13. Screenshot test: 16 files written when the env var is set (assert they exist with size > 0).

## Acceptance

- [ ] The spec builds the real local entry with `vite.local.config.mjs` and passes F1–F11 plus the final invariants in CI (`pnpm test:browser`).
- [ ] The fake implements the L5/L6 routes the adapter calls, long-poll included; `unhandled` and `violations` are empty.
- [ ] No request leaves the page origin, and none touches `/api/human` or `/_matrix/`.
- [ ] 16 screenshots are attached to the PR, with a self-critique (at most five lines) and a drift table naming an owner for each defect.
- [ ] Colour is either exercised or explicitly reported as not shipped (#972).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop and report**, without patching production code, if a flow fails because an upstream port deviates from L5/L6/L13: a wrong path, a missing `x-khala-local`, a wrong body, or the timeline not updating from `events`. Name the owning ticket (KI-140/141/142/143/144) and include the failing request from `fake.log`.
- **Stop** if, at pickup, `room.tsx` still renames through `context.room.send({ kind: 'agent_rename' })`, meaning #976 is unmerged. Under L3, local display names come only from member events, so the rename cannot work. Report it to the Executor; do not fake the rename.
- **Stop** if `vite.local.config.mjs` cannot be previewed (for example `preview` cannot find `index.html`). That is KI-143's surface.
- #978 (per-human colours) and #972 (colour picker) may change avatar colours and the menu. Refresh the selectors and the expected menu items; do not pin hues.
- Keep `maxWaitMs` small (≤ 3 s), and call `fake.close()` in `finally` so held routes never stall teardown.

## Complexity rationale

2: two new test files and no production code. The fake is the bulk, at about 250 lines of straightforward in-memory handlers over the L3 replay rules; the flows reuse existing selectors and patterns. Raise it to 3 if the Executor wants the drift review to include fixes. As written, it only reports them.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
